put.description: Windows PUT is unavailable (503 before body polling) until supported host root verification exists; GET remains available. Requires active site administrator and Admin PAT scope. Cookies and plugin/workflow credentials are not accepted. Administrator/CLI chooses the opaque ID before upload. GET 404 does not imply no staging worker. Fixed host-private package root must be durably provisioned; no root path, grants, trust or enabled intent can be supplied.

200.description: Completed or inspected operation; no trust, grants or activation implied

202.description: Verified publication awaiting host durability reconciliation

403.description: Active site administrator with Admin PAT scope required

404.description: No journal row; staging may still be active

408.description: Absolute deadline expired; inspect status, outcome may be uncertain

409.description: Active operation or immutable pin conflict

415.description: Unsupported media type or content encoding

422.description: Invalid operation identity or canonical USTAR archive

503.description: Admission/store unavailable, host reconciliation required, or Windows upload lacks supported host root verification

requestBody.description: Uncompressed canonical USTAR archive, exact EOF required; identity content encoding only. Absolute 60 second deadline, bounded bytes and fail-fast two-operation global admission. Disconnect cancels staging but cannot roll back published bytes or an in-flight commit. Same ID replay requires exact actor+descriptor.
